einzeiler: A curated preview of the most anticipated book releases arriving in August.
kurzfassung: This episode presents a selection of notable new book releases scheduled for August. The host highlights upcoming titles across multiple genres, including romance, thrillers, fantasy, and historical fiction. Listeners get plot summaries and personal insights for each recommended novel.
stichpunkte: Overview of seven notable book releases for August 2025
Romance picks feature espionage themes, fake dating, and bookshop rivalry
Thriller selections highlight psychological tension and long-buried secrets
Fantasy spotlight covers a darker, reimagined Snow White retelling
Historical fiction choice explores a World War II spy and a 1950s Paris cooking class

clips.hook: A viral video about an ex creates an unexpected social media dilemma.
clips.text: An online content creator gains attention after exposing a former college partner's poor behavior online, leading to a situation where the man must manage his public image.

clips.hook: A modern bookshop rival threatens a historic family business.
clips.text: A competitor from a long-standing local adversary family opens a sleek modern store across the street and acquires the lease for the rival family's classic shop.

clips.hook: An amateur investigation uncovers dark secrets and growing desperation.
clips.text: A reluctant helper begins searching through the past to identify other potential suspects in a murder case, creating an increasingly tense and unsettling atmosphere.

clips.hook: A potion expert tests toxins on herself to cure the forgotten.
clips.text: A specialist in healing regularly administers poisons to her own body in order to develop remedies for marginalized members of society until a royal visitor interrupts her routine.
